metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates a collection of proven exercises that target the main muscles responsible for lower back pain—designed to deliver fast relief, even in as little as 30 seconds.

Each exercise works differently, targeting specific muscles from various positions. For the best results, try them all and use the ones that give you the most relief.

Watch now and feel lower back pain melt away in seconds!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:37 Tight Muscle Massage
3:42 Twist and Lean
5:56 Cobra Scorpion
7:36 90-90 Stretch
9:41 Kneeling Lunge
